proj_tenky_body: A weather app built with the OpenWeatherMap API, originally in Java during my second year at the IUT de Paris. Rewritten in 2026 in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, replacing the endpoints that had since been deprecated.
proj_pi_body: A Discord bot that watches a Raspberry Pi over SSH from the VPS — CPU, RAM, disk, temperature, Docker containers and pending apt updates. Exposes slash commands and pushes alerts on its own, including when the Pi stops answering.
proj_vps_body: A Discord bot that watches the VPS for brute-force activity and reports it on a dedicated channel.
proj_ha_bot_body: A Discord bot that relays Home Assistant events — a door opened, a sensor tampered with, unusual energy consumption.
proj_ha_setup_sub: Home Assistant on a Raspberry Pi
proj_ha_setup_body: My home automation setup, running in Docker on a Raspberry Pi 4B with a Sonoff Zigbee dongle and Sonoff sensors — temperature, door and window contacts, smart plugs — plus Pi-hole for network-wide ad blocking. Published so the configuration is reproducible.

legal_privacy_intro: I am the controller for the personal data described here, under the GDPR and the French Data Protection Act. There is no advertising on this site, no profiling, and nothing is sold or shared beyond the providers named below.
legal_privacy_form_body: When you send a message I receive the name, email address, subject and text you entered. I use them only to read your message and reply to it. The legal basis is my legitimate interest in answering people who write to me (GDPR art. 6(1)(f)).
legal_privacy_form_recipients: Delivery goes through Resend, my email provider, acting as a processor. Messages stay in my mailbox for as long as the exchange remains useful, and at most three years after our last contact.
legal_privacy_spam_body: Each submission is checked by Friendly Captcha, which sets your browser a computational puzzle instead of tracking you, and is limited to five messages per hour per IP address. That counter lives in the server's memory for one hour and is lost whenever the site restarts; no IP address is written to disk.
legal_privacy_analytics_body: Page views are counted with Umami Cloud. It records the page you opened, where you came from, and the country, browser, operating system and screen size derived from your request. Your IP address is used to derive those and to compute a visitor hash that is regenerated daily; Umami does not store the address itself.
legal_privacy_analytics_consent: Umami writes nothing to your device and reads nothing from it, builds no profile, and follows you onto no other site. The statistics are anonymous and for my use alone, which is why they run without a consent banner.
legal_privacy_cookies_body: One cookie is set, and only if you switch language: it remembers that choice for your next visit. It is strictly necessary for a feature you asked for, so it needs no consent. Your light or dark theme and the last section you opened are kept in your browser's local storage — they stay on your device and are never sent to the server.
legal_privacy_transfers_body: Resend and Umami are United States companies and may process data there, framed by the European Commission's standard contractual clauses. The site itself is hosted in France.
legal_privacy_rights_body: You can ask to see the data I hold about you, and to have it corrected, erased, restricted or handed to you in a portable form, and you can object to its processing. Use the contact form and I will answer within a month.
legal_privacy_rights_cnil: If you believe your data is being mishandled you can complain to the CNIL, the French data protection authority, at cnil.fr.
